objects.name: Solving the Continuous Authorization Conundrum
objects.description: Key Findings Introduction Antidetect browsers conceal their users’ digital identities, enabling a single operator or small team to simultaneously run thousands of isolated accounts across multiple platforms such as Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Twitter/X, Discord, LinkedIn, Reddit, and many more, without triggering the detection systems employed by those platforms. In this report, we highlight three […] The post The Risk of AI-Powered Antidetect Browsers in Online Fraud and Influence Operations appeared first on Check Point Research .
